title: Object Storage: overage handling
content:
Object Storage overage handling is defined as follows: Treatment of usage exceeding included allowance; string.

| Contract tier | Overage handling |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB | overage handling: billing actual usage |
| Northbridge Object Storage 10 TB | overage handling: billing actual usage |
| Northbridge Object Storage 25 TB | overage handling: billing actual usage |
| Northbridge Object Storage 50 TB | overage handling: billing actual usage |
| Northbridge Object Storage 100 TB | overage handling: billing actual usage |
| Northbridge Object Storage 250 TB | overage handling: billing actual usage |

## Tier reference

For Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB, the overage handling entry is billing actual usage.
